title: Symlinks are not copied for frameworks as GDExtension dependencies on macOS
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible in: `4.5-beta3` ### System information Godot v4.5.beta3 - macOS Sequoia (15.5.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 Pro (Apple9) - Apple M4 Pro (12 threads) - 24.00 GiB memory ### Issue description When a macOS framework is added as dependency in .gdextension, its symlinks are not copied when project is exported on macOS as an APP bundle, leaving framework malformed. As a result, codesign fails: Having symlinks in .framework is a common practice. See [Anatomy of Framework Bundles](https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/MacOSX/Conceptual/BPFrameworks/Concepts/FrameworkAnatomy.html).
.gdxtension example ``` [configuration] entry_symbol = "gdextension_init" compatibility_minimum = "4.5" [libraries] macos.debug = "res://addons/sentry/bin/macos/libsentry.macos.debug.framework" macos.release = "res://addons/sentry/bin/macos/libsentry.macos.release.framework" [dependencies] macos.debug = { "res://addons/sentry/bin/macos/Sentry.framework": "" } macos.release = { "res://addons/sentry/bin/macos/Sentry.framework": "" } ```

### Steps to reproduce 1. Add a framework with symlinks as dependency for GDExtension. 2. Export project on macOS as an APP bundle. 3. Check if the resulting APP bundle contains symlinks. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) I’m afraid I don’t have a minimal project at the moment.
